description: How Ocean Plastic Isn’t The Problem. Start your 7-day free trial + unlock 4 extra months of Surfshark VPN — head to https://surfshark.com/undecided or use code UNDECIDED at checkout! I was a teenager on a cruise when I first saw ocean pollution up close. Late at night, I saw crew dumping garbage into the ocean. A stream of trash stretching off toward the horizon. But that garbage spilling into the ocean was just the tip of the trashberg. And that trashberg… is mainly plastic. Plastic makes up about 80 percent of marine pollution. And it doesn't always come from where you'd expect. Most people think of waste plastic as straws, bottles, and grocery bags washing off beaches. But when a Dutch nonprofit called The Ocean Cleanup sailed out to the Great Pacific Garbage Patch to scoop it all up… they found something else entirely.
